display.purpose: Brand names and score hero figures only.

body.purpose: Operational text, evidence snippets, controls, and report prose.

label.purpose: Metadata, table headers, chips, score labels, and terminal keys.

motion.name: state-filter
motion.purpose: Button hover and small state feedback.

motion.name: score-load
motion.purpose: Report score bar loading, disabled under reduced motion.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Sharp RGB action for scan and commit-like product actions.
components.css: .ds-button-primary { padding: 10px 18px; border-radius: 0; border: 1px solid #ff0000; background: #ff0000; color: #eeeeee; font: 700 13px/1.3 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; cursor: pointer; transition: filter 150ms ease; } .ds-button-primary:hover { filter: brightness(1.1); } .ds-button-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #ff0000; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Secondary Source Link
components.description: Compact bordered navigation affordance for report, brand, visual, and utility links.
components.css: .ds-source-link { width: fit-content; display: inline-flex; min-height: 28px; align-items: center; border: 1px solid #28302d; padding: 3px 8px; background: #121615; color: #dedbd2; font: 12px/1.4 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; text-decoration: none; } .ds-source-link:hover, .ds-source-link:focus-visible { border-color: #ff0000; color: #ff0000; outline: 2px solid #ff0000; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Panel
components.description: Flat bordered operational container for forms, tables, reports, and health state.
components.css: .ds-panel { background: rgba(18, 22, 21, 0.76); border: 1px solid #28302d; border-radius: 0; padding: 16px; color: #dedbd2; font: 13px/1.5 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; }

components.name: Status Chip
components.css: .ds-chip-ok { display: inline-block; padding: 1px 8px; border-radius: 2px; font: 12px/1.5 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; border: 1px solid #00ff00; color: #00ff00; background: transparent; }

components.name: Report Drawer
components.description: Right-side technical reading drawer for tiles, citations, and acquisition details.
components.css: .ds-report-drawer { width: min(620px, calc(100dvw - 24px)); height: calc(100dvh - 24px); border: 1px solid #28302d; border-radius: 0; background: #121615; color: #dedbd2; box-shadow: -18px 0 42px rgb(0 0 0 / 48%); overflow: auto; scrollbar-width: none; font: 13px/1.5 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; } .ds-report-drawer header { position: sticky; top: 0; padding: 16px; border-bottom: 1px solid #28302d; background: #121615; font-size: 28px; font-weight: 700; } .ds-report-drawer section { margin: 14px; border: 1px solid #28302d; padding: 16px 18px; }

narrative.overview: B3S is a technical observatory for brand evidence, not a decorative analytics product. The interface should feel like a calibration desk where each number, citation, visual capture, tile, and acquisition warning can be inspected under controlled conditions.
keyCharacteristics: Mono typography across UI, data, controls, reports, and labels.
Day/night themes using actual RGB red, green, and blue as system colors.
Rectilinear panels, sharp controls, visible borders, and minimal radius.
Progressive disclosure: summary on the card, evidence and tile detail in drawers.
Brand-first report hierarchy: brand name, URL, score, margin, then components.

rules.name: The RGB Semantics Rule
rules.body: Red, green, and blue are system signals. Use them sparingly and literally; never replace missing evidence with yellow.

rules.name: The No Beige Drift Rule
rules.body: The historical design/DESIGN.md beige/Fraunces/Manrope direction is not the active B3S UI language unless a task explicitly asks to revive that branch.

rules.name: The One Font Rule
rules.body: Do not introduce a second family for product UI. If a future brand surface needs a different font, scope it to that surface.

rules.name: The Border Is Structure Rule
rules.body: Use 1px borders and layout rhythm before reaching for shadows.

dos: Do preserve the brand-first report hierarchy: brand name, URL, score, immediate margin, then cards.
Do keep report rows and cards comparable by using stable widths, explicit grid spans, and predictable score badges.
Do put long tile explanations, citations, acquisition limitations, and rejected content behind drawers or secondary panels.
Do use visible text labels for evidence status; color alone is not enough.
Do keep day/night themes aligned by role, not by unrelated palettes.
donts: Don't make B3S look like a generic SaaS dashboard, CRM, investor analytics panel, or AI startup landing page.
Don't use beige editorial Brand3 styling as the default active UI.
Don't use yellow for not detected or missing evidence.
Don't add purple gradients, glassmorphism, glossy AI surfaces, decorative charts, or marketing hero layouts.
Don't create nested cards, repeated equal-weight card grids, or page sections styled as floating cards.
Don't expose all tile information on the first report view when the drawer can carry the explanation.
